1301.note: Narváez, EHMCM 38 (2009) pp. 139-143, says Torrens's reserved notes 2 (23 Jan 1826) and 3 (9 Apr 1826) are wholly in his 10 x 7 matrix cipher, and prints that cipher's full key and its method from the official instruction sheet, AHDSREM exp. 5-16-8615 ff. 27-29. Anyone holding scans can therefore decipher the notes directly. The 'Dos criptosistemas' article (2007-08) in which Narváez analysed the two notes is still not online, and it may already print their decipherment. The code materials he calls poorly preserved are separate documents, not identified here, and could become their own lead if located.
1301.access_note: AHDSREM (SRE, Mexico City) reading room; the notes are not online. EHMCM 38 is online at moderna.historicas.unam.mx (PDF read 16 Nov 2026).

vetting.by: claude session 16 Nov 2026 (Claude Opus 5.5), wave 20 vetting

seen.where: Narváez, 'El "Diario reservado No. 18" (1829) de José Anastasio Torrens', Estudios de Historia Moderna y Contemporánea de México 38 (2009) 139-163, PDF https://moderna.historicas.unam.mx/index.php/ehm/article/download/17768/16948/25169, pp. 139-144 read 16 Nov 2026. The notes themselves (AHDSREM) were not seen.
seen.extent: Two reserved notes, 2 and 3 of 1826, said to be entirely in cipher. Their length is not given in the article read.
seen.cipher: A numeric syllabic cipher: words are split into one- or two-letter fractions, each enciphered as column digit + row digit(s) of a 10 x 7 matrix whose first five rows repeat the vowels ('Sa' = 871, 'n' = 57). The key is printed on p. 143 from the 1824 'Clave para descifrar las comunicaciones reservadas, remitida a Torrens' (AHDSREM 5-16-8615 ff. 27-29).

prior_art.decode: known.py was run earlier (Oct-Nov 2026) on Torrens, the AHGE/AHDSREM and Narváez, finding only this lead and the Obregón lead 1300 (closed read). The DECODE dumps hold no Mexican SRE record.

prior_art.lasry: Lasry's list (cryptiana GL.htm, fetched 15 Nov 2026) has no hit for Torrens.
prior_art.edition: Narváez, 'Dos criptosistemas empleados por el coronel José A. Torrens en Colombia (1825-1826)', Memorias de la Academia Mexicana de la Historia 49 (2007-08) 7-43, is devoted to notes 2 and 3 (EHMCM 38 p. 139). It was not seen, so whether it prints their plaintext is unchecked. Documenta & Instrumenta 6 (2008) n. 25 says several messages Torrens enciphered by this method have been published in clear.
prior_art.literature: Narváez, EHMCM 38 (2009) prints the key and the deciphered Diario reservado 18 (1829) in the same system. Historia Mexicana 231 (2009) n. 52 mentions only a 'decodificación precaria' of a manuscript presumed to be Torrens's in his code (from the earlier vetting, research/vetting_2026-11-13_ajbeling/vetting.json).

vetting.key_check: The full key of the matrix cipher is printed in EHMCM 38 (2009) p. 143 from AHDSREM 5-16-8615 ff. 27-29, and Narváez states that notes 2 and 3 of 1826 are wholly in it. It was not tested here because the ciphertext is not online.
vetting.duplicates: Lead 1300 (Obregón 1825, closed read) is a sibling Mexican system, not the same documents. No catalogue entry covers Torrens's notes.
vetting.closed: Closed as key lookup: the system's full key is printed (EHMCM 38, 2009, p. 143) and the two 1826 notes are stated to be wholly in it, so nothing remains to break. Narváez's 2007-08 study of the same notes may already give their plaintext. Torrens's code pieces, which are poorly preserved and unidentified here, would need their own lead.

2853.note: All 96 images were paged through on 16 Nov 2026. The file holds a single enciphered telegram: images 003 and 005, D 109, Valencia Guerra no. 19072, 20/224, 16:40, from the President of the Council of Ministers and War Minister to the President of the Generalitat, strips of four-figure groups headed 'Clave general T en H'. Image 002 is its typed decipherment with the same header ('D 109 BAR VALENCIA GUERRA 19072 20/224 2 16/40'), noting 'CLAVE GENERAL T en H (Te en Hache)' and giving the full clear text on the Aragon front. The other cipher-labelled piece, images 066-068 ('(Telegrama cifrado)', Irujo/Basque President to Negrín, 17 Nov 1937), is itself a clear typed text. Everything else is clear letters, reports and telegrams.

BayHStA gda.bayern.de finding aid re-read 16 Nov 2026 (Kasten blau 61/30 page: 'Medium: A = Analoges Archivale', no digital object); the unit is still analogue only. Its wording is a bare 'Chiffren' in a mixed correspondence file, which the same describer uses differently from 'nicht aufgelöste Chiffren' (61/3) and 'entschlüsselte Chiffren' (62/9 II), so the pieces may be key sheets rather than ciphertext. Tomokiyo's and Lasry's lists (fetched 15 Nov 2026) have no Pfalz-Neuburg, Kasten blau or correspondent hit. The recorded blocker stands.
